surface_mechanism_description: The ALD chemistry of MoO3 deposition involves two half-reactions where molybdenum hexacarbonyl reacts with surface species to form surface intermediates, followed by reaction with ozone to form the final product. The surface species are denoted by |-O.
evidence: Following the work of Diskus et al, the ALD chemistry of MoO3 deposition can be split to two half reactions: Mo(CO)6(g) + |-O |-O-Mo(CO)0.5 + 5.5 CO(g); |-O-Mo(CO)0.5 + O3(g) |-O-Mo-O3 + 0.5 CO(g); where |-O denotes the surface species.
